csv_project_name: AE for Community Center Remodel Project
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Granby, New York ( Town ) invites sealed proposals from qualified architectural firms licensed and authorized to practice architecture in the State of New York to provide professional architectural design and related consulting services for the remodel of the Town s community center. New York public entities commonly procure architectural and engineering consultant contracts based on qualifications and experience, and municipalities are advised to clearly define the scope, schedule, submission requirements, and evaluation criteria in the solicitation. The selected firm is expected to assist the Town with project initiation through design, preparation of permit-ready and bid-ready construction documents, and bidding support only. Industry guidance recognizes construction documents and bidding as distinct services, while construction administration may be included only at the owner s discretion and can be excluded from the requested scope.
